messages.subject: loading file above shiny server
parts:
I'm working on a Shiny app that loads in a yml configuration file, I'd like to do this before the server logic.

library(yaml)

conf <- yaml.load_file("my_config_file.yml")

files <- lapply(conf$directories, list.files)

shinyServer({
   server_stuff_here
})

Error in lapply(obj, function(val) { : object 'conf' not found

According the documentation the code above the server should be run once when the app starts. Why does this not work?
I can manually load the yml file into the global environment before running the app, this allows the app to run normally.

Any ideas?

messages.author: 8a732eca9bfcf407
messages.subject: Re: loading file above shiny server
parts:
Solved it by moving the header code to global.R,

Does anyone know where this is documented?
